title: Dominic and the Portrait
author: Noor Eriksen
blurb: Silas Oyelaran, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
